import csv, sys, statistics

from datetime import date

def load(path):
    data = defaultdict(lambda: defaultdict(list))  # item -> weekday -> [qty]
    with open(path, newline="") as f:

def forecast(data, target):
    wd = target.weekday()
    out = {}
    for item, by_day in data.items():
        vals = by_day.get(wd, [])
        if not vals:

        out[item] = round(statistics.mean(vals) * 1.1)  # 10% buffer
    return out
